backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic implemented.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, related files, components, tests, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing human-written summaries of key frontend source files.
frontend/.env.example: Environment variable template explaining single- or dual-URL ActivePieces webhook configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions establishing color tokens and light/dark mode.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level component selecting SignInPage or DashboardPage based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/components/AskAI/AskAIModul: UI module for submitting AI questions, displaying answers, and handling loading, clearing, and context checks.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: Drag-and-drop file uploader with preview, browse option, and upload/clear controls.
Layout component providing header, footer, and main content wrapper with a sign‑out button.
frontend/src/components/Quiz/Interactive: Interactive quiz renderer with per-question answer selection and correctness feedback.
frontend/src/components/Quiz/QuizSection: Quiz wrapper providing visibility toggling and deletion around InteractiveQuiz.
frontend/src/components/SummaryCard.tsx: Card component displaying the generated summary or an empty state prompt.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including loading, login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base file defining light/dark theme variables and global styles.
frontend/src/lib/activepieces.ts: Functions to upload files and send AI questions to backend endpoints with strict response validation.
frontend/src/lib/env.ts: Utility functions resolving API endpoint URLs from environment variables with fallbacks and error handling.
frontend/src/lib/types.ts: Type definitions for quiz items and responses from upload and AI actions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page handling file upload, summary display, quiz rendering, and AI question interactions.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Sign‑in page enabling Internet Identity login with basic status and error display.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending fonts, colors, animations, and container settings, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing an AI-driven learning dashboard with webhook-based backend flows, local React state management, and a list of existing feature definitions.
